description: Use this when the user asks a factual question the live web can answer in a sentence or a few fields, such as a company's founding year, a CEO's name or a product's current price. Searches and reads the pages itself and returns the answer with its source URLs, optionally as a flat JSON object of the fields you list in `json`. For a list of items from one page (latest blog posts, a price table), call scrape_website on that page instead.

json.description: Optional shape for the answer: a flat JSON object of the fields you want. Example: { "book_title": "", "author": "", "release_date": "" }. Keep it flat. Deeply nested shapes or long lists are unreliable.

task.description: Question or task to answer using web data.

name: answers
title: Answers
